spans.s:
रम् (ङ, औ, उ) रमते 1.
d. To sport, play.
With आ, उप or वि to rest, stop.

रम (मः-मा-मं)
a. Dear, charming.
m. A husband;
Kāma; Jonesia
asoca.
f. (मा)
Lakshmi; a wife.

राम (मः-मा-मं)
a. Black; white;
pleasing.
m. Rāma, a name com-
mon to three incarnations
Pu-
rashurāma, Rāmachandra, and
Balarāma; a horse.
f. A fine
woman; a river; asafoetida.
n. A
potherb, sort of costus.

रमक (कः) 1.
m. A lover.

रमठ (ठं) 1.
n. Asafoetida.

रामठ (ठं) 1.
n. Asafoetida.

रमठ-ध्वनि (निः) 2.
m. Idem.

रमण (नः-णा-णं)
a. Pleasing.
m. Kāma;
a husband; a lover; an ass.
f.
(णा-णी) A fine woman.
n. A cu-
cumber; coition; dalliance.

रमणीय (यः-या-यं)
a. Beautiful.

रमणीयता (ता) 1.
f. Agreeableness.

रमण्य (ण्यं) 1.
n. Sport, dalliance.

रमति (तिः) 2.
m. A lover; para-
dise; a crow; time
Kāma.

रममान (नः-ना-नं)
p. Sporting.

रमा_पति (तिः) 2.
m. Viṣṇu.

रमा_प्रिय (यं) 1.
n. The lotus.

रम्भ (म्भः) 1.
m. A bambu.
f. (म्भा) A
plantain; a harlot; lowing.

राम्भ (म्भः) 1.
m. The bambu staff of
a religious student.

रम्भित (तः-ता-तं) 1.
m. n. f. Lowing of kine.

रम्य (म्यः-म्या-म्यं)
a. Pleasing, hand-
some.
m. Michelia champaca.
f.
Night; name of a river^1.
n. A cu-
cumber; semen virile.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar, jim funderburk on 20210816. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/73.

रम्यक (कं) 1.
n. One of the minor
dwīpas or divisions of the world.
Also रमणक and रमण्यक.

रम्यता (ता) 1.
f. Agreeableness.

रम्र (म्रः) 1.
m. Purple or the colour
of the dawn; beauty, splendor.

रामकरी (री) 3.
f. A
Rāginī.

राम-कर्पूर (रः) 1.
m. A fragrant grass.

राम-कली (ली) 3.
f. A
Rāginī.

राम-गिरि (रिः) 2.
m. A mountain.

राम-चन्द्र (न्द्रः) 1.
m. Rāmchandra the
second incarnation of
Viṣṇu.

राम-जननी (नी) 3.
f. The mother of
Balarāma or of
Rāma.

रामणीयक (कः-का-कं)
a. Beautiful,
pleasing.
n. Pleasing.

राम-दूत (तः) 1.
m. The monkey
Ha-
numān. f. (तिः-ती) A shrub, basil.

राम-पूग (गः) 1.
m. A small species
of the areca or betel-nut tree.

राम-भद्र (द्रः) 1.
m. Rāmachandra.

राम-वीणा (णाः) 1.
f. A sort of lute.

राम-शर (रः) 1.
m. A sort of grass.

राम-सख (खः) 1.
m. The monkey
king
Sugriva, ally of
Rāma.

रामा_यण(णं) 1.
n. An epic poem of the
Hindus celebrating
Rāmchandra.

रामिल (लः) 1.
m. Kāma; a lover.
